# Arguments, logging and random numbers

C# methods for a **Run C# code** step. See [C# methods](index.md) for how to use them.

## TryGetArg

Reads one of the action's variables (the %name% words) by its name. The version with a type turns the value into that type for you, like text or a whole number.

```csharp
bool TryGetArg<T>(string argName, out T value)
bool TryGetArg(string argName, out object? value)
```

**Gives back:** true and the value when the variable exists (and fits the type), otherwise false. Always false while Init() runs outside an action.

**Example**

```csharp
if (CPH.TryGetArg("user", out string user))
{
    CPH.LogInfo($"Hello {user}!");
}
```

## SetArgument

Sets a variable (a %name% word) for the rest of this action, so later sub-actions can use it. Only works while an action runs, not from Init().

```csharp
void SetArgument(string variableName, object? value)
```

**Gives back:** Nothing.

**Example**

```csharp
CPH.SetArgument("prize", "a free song request");
```

## GetSource

Tells you which kind of event started this action, like Twitch or Command. Gives None when you ran the action by hand.

```csharp
EventSource GetSource()
```

**Gives back:** The event source, or None when it is unknown.

**Example**

```csharp
var source = CPH.GetSource();
CPH.LogInfo($"Started by: {source}");
```

## GetEventType

Tells you exactly which event started this action, like TwitchFollow or TwitchCheer. Gives None when it is unknown or you ran the action by hand.

```csharp
EventType GetEventType()
```

**Gives back:** The event type, or None.

**Example**

```csharp
var type = CPH.GetEventType();
CPH.LogInfo($"Event: {type}");
```

## LogInfo

Writes a normal line to Cuebot's log. Handy to see what your code is doing.

```csharp
void LogInfo(string message)
```

**Gives back:** Nothing.

**Example**

```csharp
CPH.LogInfo("The raid alert started.");
```

## LogWarn

Writes a warning line to Cuebot's log. Use it when something looks wrong but your code can go on.

```csharp
void LogWarn(string message)
```

**Gives back:** Nothing.

**Example**

```csharp
CPH.LogWarn("No game name was given, using Just Chatting.");
```

## LogError

Writes an error line to Cuebot's log. Use it when something failed.

```csharp
void LogError(string message)
```

**Gives back:** Nothing.

**Example**

```csharp
CPH.LogError("Could not reach the song list.");
```

## LogDebug

Writes a debug line to Cuebot's log, for extra details while you test your code.

```csharp
void LogDebug(string message)
```

**Gives back:** Nothing.

**Example**

```csharp
CPH.LogDebug("Checking the viewer list now.");
```

## LogVerbose

Writes a very detailed line to Cuebot's log. In Cuebot this is the same as LogDebug.

```csharp
void LogVerbose(string message)
```

**Gives back:** Nothing.

**Example**

```csharp
CPH.LogVerbose("Loop step 3 done.");
```

## Wait

Pauses your code for a number of milliseconds (1000 = 1 second). It stops early when the action is cancelled or the script runs out of time.

```csharp
void Wait(int milliseconds)
```

**Gives back:** Nothing.

**Example**

```csharp
CPH.Wait(2000);
CPH.LogInfo("Two seconds later.");
```

## Between

Picks a random whole number between two numbers. Both ends can be picked. If you swap them by mistake, it still works.

```csharp
int Between(int min, int max)
```

**Gives back:** A random whole number from min to max.

**Example**

```csharp
int roll = CPH.Between(1, 6);
CPH.LogInfo($"You rolled a {roll}!");
```

## NextDouble

Picks a random number from 0 up to (but not including) 1. Handy for chances, like a 25% win.

```csharp
double NextDouble()
```

**Gives back:** A random number from 0 to just under 1.

**Example**

```csharp
double chance = CPH.NextDouble();
CPH.LogInfo(chance < 0.25 ? "You win!" : "Try again.");
```

## GetVersion

Gives you Cuebot's version number. (Streamer.bot gives its own version; Cuebot gives Cuebot's.)

```csharp
string GetVersion()
```

**Gives back:** Cuebot's version as text.

**Example**

```csharp
string version = CPH.GetVersion();
CPH.LogInfo($"Cuebot version {version}");
```
